title: skills eval: narrow analytics-inline-vs-dataset#5 must_not_contain to the defineDataset( call, and fifteen same-shape cases
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D4n2wzAmmp4Z6W5jsqtM2qx)_
Fixes #35095
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：用户无感。技能评测里，答对的回答只是提到「这里不需要某个写法」时，不再被判错；写错的回答照旧判错。
- 为什么做：属于「技能教得好不好」这条评测线，判分只做字面匹配，一条正在进行的前后对比因此多记了一次失败。
- 出错会怎样：最坏是个别评测题放过一种没写代码、只用文字描述的错误做法；改动只有评测数据，撤回这一个提交即可。
- 要你做什么：无。十六道题换了判分词，旧轮次里这十六道要重跑后才能和新轮次比较。

## What changes

`grade.ts` (`packages/qa/scenarios/src/skill-evals/grade.ts`) matches every `must_not_contain` entry as a literal, case-sensitive substring of the answer. A bare identifier therefore fails a correct answer that names it as the thing to avoid. `objectstack-ui` `analytics-inline-vs-dataset` case 5 forbade `defineDataset`, and the bundle's own entry file puts that name beside the rule ("names a `defineDataset` … an ad-hoc chart in a `kind: 'react'` page needs none"), so an answer saying the chart "doesn't need a `defineDataset`" failed.

Sixteen cases now forbid the spelling a wrong answer writes. Only `must_not_contain` entries move: no prompt, reference answer, `must_contain` entry or skill text changes, and every file keeps its line count.

| Case | Before | After |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `objectstack-ui/analytics-inline-vs-dataset#5` | `defineDataset` | `defineDataset(` |
| `objectstack-ui/analytics-inline-vs-dataset#1` | `categoryField` | `categoryField:` |
| `objectstack-ui/record-page#2` | `definePage` | `definePage(` |
| `objectstack-ui/views-apps-actions-pages#4` | `record_detail` | `type: 'record_detail'` |
| `objectstack-ui/views-apps-actions-pages#5` | `sourceView` | `sourceView:` |
| `objectstack-ui/views-apps-actions-pages#9` | `disabledMessage`, `disabledTooltip` | `disabledMessage:`, `disabledTooltip:` |
| `objectstack-data/hooks-security-seeds-datasources#4` | `defineDataset` | `defineDataset(` |
| `objectstack-data/hooks-security-seeds-datasources#5` | `readonlyWhen` | `readonlyWhen:` |
| `objectstack-data/hooks-security-seeds-datasources#8` | `assigned_to` | `assigned_to:` |
| `objectstack-query/filters-pagination-search#6` | `subDays` | `subDays:` |
| `objectstack-platform/config-plugins-ops#4` | `@objectstack/adapter-` | the same prefix opened by a single or a double quote |
| `objectstack-platform/config-plugins-ops#7` | `admin_full_access` | `'admin_full_access'`, `"admin_full_access"` |
| `objectstack-i18n/bundles-locales-coverage#4` | `getAppBundle`, `loadAppBundle` | `getAppBundle(`, `loadAppBundle(` |
| `objectstack-i18n/bundles-locales-coverage#6` | `permissionSets` | `permissionSets:`, `permissionSets.` |
| `objectui/app-composition#2` | `pageName` | `pageName:` and its JSON-quoted key |
| `objectui/app-composition#4` | `pageName`, `viewName` | `pageName:`, `viewName:` and their JSON-quoted keys |

## Evals

**The pass.** Read on `origin/main` at `cf6bb70e`, re-read at `eca20d22`: 219 behaviour cases carry 451 `must_not_contain` entries. 119 entries in 80 cases are a bare identifier (one word-shaped token: letters, digits, `_ . : / @ -`, no trailing colon or dot). The other 332 already carry syntax and were not judged. A case was narrowed only when all three hold:

1. the bundle's own text, or the case's reference answer, states a negative about that name ("not", "never", "there is no", deprecated, refused);
2. that negative is the rule this case grades, so a correct answer is on the subject;
3. a wrong use has a code spelling a mention lacks.

<details><summary>Narrowed: 16 cases, and the sentence each rests on</summary>

- `objectstack-ui/analytics-inline-vs-dataset#5`: `SKILL.md` trap 3 (quoted above).
- `objectstack-ui/analytics-inline-vs-dataset#1`: `rules/dashboards.md`, "the closed schema rejects `object` / `categoryField` / `valueField` / `aggregate` by name". The sibling `valueField:` already had its colon.
- `objectstack-ui/record-page#2`: the reference answer is one `navigation` declaration with nothing else authored, for a request that says "full page"; case 1 of the same file already forbids `definePage(`.
- `objectstack-ui/views-apps-actions-pages#4`: `rules/pages.md`, "There is no `record_detail`, `app_launcher` or `utility_bar` type".
- `objectstack-ui/views-apps-actions-pages#5`: `rules/navigation.md`, "`sourceView` … is deprecated legacy"; the reference answer says "no deprecated source view".
- `objectstack-ui/views-apps-actions-pages#9`: `rules/actions.md`, "`disabledMessage` / `disabledTooltip` / … are refused naming this key".
- `objectstack-data/hooks-security-seeds-datasources#4`: `references/seeds.md`, "The factory is `defineSeed`, not `defineDataset`".
- `objectstack-data/hooks-security-seeds-datasources#5`: `SKILL.md`, `readonlyWhen` locks "for everyone; per permission set → field permission `when`", which is the contrast this case grades.
- `objectstack-data/hooks-security-seeds-datasources#8`: `SKILL.md`, "Never a per-record `assigned_to` picklist".
- `objectstack-query/filters-pagination-search#6`: `rules/filters.md`, "any extra key (there is no `subDays`)".
- `objectstack-platform/config-plugins-ops#4`: `SKILL.md`, "There are no `@objectstack/adapter-*` packages"; the reference answer says the same.
- `objectstack-platform/config-plugins-ops#7`: `SKILL.md`, "a platform set such as `admin_full_access` is refused".
- `objectstack-i18n/bundles-locales-coverage#4`: `SKILL.md`, "`getAppBundle` / `loadAppBundle` went with the `o.*` shape they returned".
- `objectstack-i18n/bundles-locales-coverage#6`: the reference answer says the group is `permissions`, "not the camelCase name".
- `objectui/app-composition#2`: `guides/app-composition.md` lists `{type:'page', pageName}` as "Bare SDUI rendering only -- no object shell", and the prompt asks whether to build a page.
- `objectui/app-composition#4`: the same guide, "`filters` is mutually exclusive with `recordId`/`viewName`".

</details>

<details><summary>Left strict: 10 cases where a correct answer may name the token, and a mention and a wrong use share one spelling</summary>

A fail on one of these is a cue to read the answer, as the existing note on `analytics-inline-vs-dataset#2` says of its own entry.

- `objectstack-ui/analytics-inline-vs-dataset#2` `dateGranularity`: already carries that note; left as authored.
- `objectstack-ask/metric-selection-fallback#1`, `#7` `aggregate_records`: the answer is a plan in prose, where naming the tool is using it.
- `objectstack-automation/flows-triggers-approvals#7` `current_user.positions`: the bundle says "never on `current_user.positions` inside it"; a wrong use is a predicate with no one spelling.
- `objectstack-automation/flows-triggers-approvals#23` `STACK_TRIGGER_CAPABILITY_REQUIRED`: a wrong diagnosis and a ruled-out one both name the code in prose.
- `objectstack-i18n/bundles-locales-coverage#13` `hooks.submit_signoff`: a key path ruled out is spelled as the wrong answer spells it.
- `objectstack-platform/config-plugins-ops#2` `data:beforeInsert`: the bundle's own don't-example is the call a wrong answer writes.
- `objectstack-project/project-process#6` `docs/requirements`, `REQ-`: asking for a requirement record and declining one both name the path.
- `objectstack-query/filters-pagination-search#9` `date_trunc`: the bundle says "never `date_trunc`", and the answer explains the bucketing in prose.
- `objectui/project-setup#3` `@object-ui/plugin-grid/style.css`: a wrong import has several spellings (JS import in either quote, CSS import).

</details>

<details><summary>Left as they are: 54 cases where a correct answer has no reason to name the token</summary>

The bundle never spells the token as a negative, or the negative is not what the case grades, or the token is a word of the reply itself.

- `objectstack-ai/skills-tools-knowledge#3` (`chunkSize`, `topK`): the bundle spells neither; the reference answer says chunking and top-K in words.
- `objectstack-api/endpoints-auth-routes#3` (`kernel:ready`, `getService`): the bundle spells neither.
- `objectstack-ask/metric-selection-fallback#2`, `#3`, `#8`, `#10` (tool names, measure machine names): the reply is a question and nothing else, showing labels; any appearance is the wrong pattern. `#4`, `#9`, `#11` (`provenance`, tool names): a fallback or a stop has none to cite. `#5`, `#14`, `#15` (`typical`, `probably`, `unknown`): words of the reply; the word is the wrong pattern.
- `objectstack-automation/flows-triggers-approvals#5` (`query_record`): the case has no fetch step. `#10` (`lock_record`), `#13` (`_copy`, `beforeUpdate`), `#24` (`isActive`): not spelled by the bundle as a negative. `#11` (`sudo`): the bundle's sentence is about hooks, the case about a flow. `#12` (`assigned_to`, `record-after-create`), `#19` (`sys_approval_request`): no negative about either in this bundle. `#20`, `#21` (package-qualified names): the bundle spells none; "no package-qualified name" is said in words.
- `objectstack-automation/integrations-declared#1` (`connector-esign`): invented name, not in the bundle.
- `objectstack-data/hooks-security-seeds-datasources#8` (`beforeInsert`): the bundle says "a hook that picks an owner" in words. `#9` (`starts_with`): not in the bundle. `#10`, `#12`, `#23` (`HookContext`): taught as a type name, never as a negative.
- `objectstack-data/objects-fields-relationships#1` (`vendorName`): not in the bundle. `#8` (`many_to_many`): the case has no many-to-many. `#16` (`trackHistory`): the reference answer says "field history" in words.
- `objectstack-formula/cel-predicates-formulas#8` (three `currency:` forms), `#11` (`joinNonEmpty`): no negative about them.
- `objectstack-i18n/bundles-locales-coverage#2` (`ja_JP`), `#3` (`_meta`), `#5` (`messageFormat`), `#7` (`stepLabel`, `_tabs.overview`), `#8`, `#9` (wrong key paths), `#15` (`_hooks`): each is a wrong key or path the case's rule does not name.
- `objectstack-platform/config-plugins-ops#2` (`onInstall`): the bundle does not spell it. `#3` (`@objectstack/adapter-`), `#6` (`@objectstack/plugin-prometheus`): not the rule these cases grade. `#9` (`assigned_to`, `beforeInsert`), `#16` (`OS_DEV_CRYPTO_KEY`): no negative in this bundle.
- `objectstack-project/project-process#2` (`readdirSync`), `#5` (`eslint-disable`): not in the bundle.
- `objectstack-ui/analytics-inline-vs-dataset#6`, `#8` (`beforeUpdate`): the bundle does not spell it; the reference answer says "no hook" in words.
- `objectstack-ui/report-period-export#1` (`permissions.export`, `canExport`): invented keys.
- `objectstack-ui/views-apps-actions-pages#2` (`pageName`): a valid key the bundle teaches. `#20`, `#21` (`hooks.` key paths): no negative about them in this bundle.
- `objectui/app-composition`: none left. `objectui/data-integration#2` (`enableBrowser`, `setupWorker`), `objectui/project-setup#1`, `#2`, `#3` (`create-react-app`, `node_modules/@object-ui`, `@object-ui/plugin-ai`), `objectui/protocol#1` (`style.css`, `ComponentRegistry.register`): the reference answers rule these out in words, and the guides give no negative sentence carrying the token.

</details>

**What was re-run, and what was not.** No model round was run: `skill-evals` needs the maintainer's subscription login, which this session does not hold. Case 5 was graded through `gradeAnswer` itself with two hand-written answers, against the case as `origin/main` has it and as this branch has it:

| Answer | `origin/main` (`defineDataset`) | this branch (`defineDataset(`) |
|:---|:---|:---|
| Inline `ObjectChart` with `aggregate` / `groupBy`, plus "it doesn't need a `defineDataset`" | fail, forbidden `defineDataset` | pass |
| A `defineDataset({ … })` call and a chart naming it | fail, forbidden `defineDataset` | fail, forbidden `defineDataset(` |

**The scorecard.** A round's records carry `caseHash`, a hash of the prompt and both token lists. All sixteen hashes change (case 5: `ef5ee71d` → `2885acc4`), so `skill-evals --regrade` on a round recorded before this change sets these cases apart and its summary names them outside every pass rate. The changeset states the same for the package changelog, which is where case changes are recorded. A before/after reading that includes any of the sixteen needs both rounds run on this side of the change; six of them are `objectstack-ui` cases.

## Acceptance notes

- `objectstack-platform/config-plugins-ops#4` gives up one wrong answer: a bare `pnpm add` of an adapter package with no import and no `package.json` entry shown. Every other narrowing keeps each code spelling of the wrong use in a single-quoted, colon-keyed or called form; a wrong use written only in prose, or in double quotes where the entry is single-quoted, now passes.
- The same token stays bare where the case does not grade its negative: `assigned_to` in `flows-triggers-approvals#12` and `config-plugins-ops#9`, `@objectstack/adapter-` in `config-plugins-ops#3`, `pageName` in `views-apps-actions-pages#2`.
- Not this shape, noted only: `views-apps-actions-pages#8` forbids the template-literal spelling of `record.name`, and an answer that uses the right form and quotes the wrong one in a warning fails. The wrong use and the warning share one spelling, so no narrowing separates them.
- `skill-evals --dry-run` and `--self-test` were not measured here: the CLI imports `@objectstack/spec` from `dist/`, which this worktree did not build. The reader they exercise was run directly, as above.
